svg.title: How Power keeps running through maintenance
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Many updates are applied in place. Some maintenance may require Live Partition Mobility. The result IBM claims is zero planned downtime for system maintenance, based upon IBM internal testing of system upgrade scenarios.

svg.text: ZERO PLANNED DOWNTIME FOR SYSTEM MAINTENANCE*

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: * IBM's claim for Power, based upon IBM internal testing of system upgrade scenarios. Many updates (VIOS, hot plug adapters, I/O adapter firmware and concurrent

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: system firmware updates) can be done in place; some (non-concurrent system firmware and hardware maintenance) may require Live Partition Mobility (LPM) support.
